title: Mr J Royston and Mrs V Royston v Lady Jennifer Green: 3400296/2016 and 3400297/2016
text:
EMPLOYMENT TRIBUNALS

Claimant:		  1. Mr J Royston
			  2. Mrs V Royston

Respondent:	  Lady Jennifer Green

HEARD AT:	  Bury St Edmunds		ON:    25 July 2016

BEFORE:		  Employment Judge Laidler


REPRESENTATION

For the Claimant:	          Ms Bewley, Counsel		

For the Respondent:	 Ms Bollard, Counsel


JUDGMENT

1.	All claims of both Claimants’, save for that of 3 days outstanding time in lieu, are struck due to the Claimants non-attendance at this hearing.

2.	The monies conceded by the Respondents in its letter of the 8 June 2016 to the Employment Tribunal remain due and payable.



____________________________________

Employment Judge Laidler

JUDGMENT SENT TO THE PARTIES ON

........................................................................

........................................................................

FOR THE SECRETARY TO THE TRIBUNALS


Reasons for the judgment having been given orally at the hearing, written reasons will not be provided unless a request was made by either party at the hearing or a written request is presented by either party within 14 days of the sending of this written record of the decision.
description: Employment Tribunal Decision of Judge Laidler on 1 August 2016.
